input.quote: 2.1 Hosting Software License. Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, Commerce One hereby grants to Corio a fee-bearing, perpetual and irrevocable, nonexclusive, nontransferable (except in accordance with Section 14.1 of this Agreement), right and license in the Territory to (i) reproduce the Software in machine executable object code format only for installation on the Corio Servers;
input.rationale: The grant is perpetual and irrevocable (2.1) and the paid-up internal-use licence is perpetual (2.3/2.2), and Section 14.1 permits assignment to a successor in a merger, acquisition or asset sale, so the irrevocability and successor-transfer elements meet the playbook. However, every licence in Section 2 runs to "Corio" only: affiliates are never mentioned anywhere in the Agreement, contractors are not covered (only "Corio Servers" contemplates operation "by or for Corio"), and Section 2.7 expressly bars allowing access except as explicitly permitted, so there is no path to add affiliates or contractors. That fails the fallback (affiliates covered on written notice) on a material term, so we add a short subsection extending the Section 2 licences to affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, with Corio remaining responsible for their compliance. Minor point noted only: the 14.1 assignment right carries a direct-competitor consent carve-out, which we accept.

proposal.summary: Extend the Section 2 licences to Corio's affiliates and to contractors acting on Corio's behalf
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short subsection confirming that the Section 2 licences extend to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, with Corio remaining responsible for their compliance, since the grant as drafted is limited to Corio alone and Section 2.7 bars any other access. If preferred, we can instead cover affiliates on written notice to Commerce One.

ops.text: 2.11 Affiliates and Contractors. The licenses granted to Corio under this Section 2 extend to Corio's affiliates (meaning any entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with Corio) and to contractors acting on Corio's behalf, in each case subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement. Corio shall remain responsible for such affiliates' and contractors' compliance with this Agreement.
